explanation: Product under review: a portable lithium-ion power bank (rechargeable battery pack with an integrated DC output) imported into Brazil. Reviewed local intelligence supports a primary NCM classification candidate of 8507.60.00 (lithium-ion accumulators) over the alternative 8504.40.90 (static converters), because the essential character of the good is the rechargeable battery rather than the conversion circuit. This is evidence-backed decision support for a future vLatamGlobal Classifier review; it is not a final tariff ruling or customs clearance decision.
